answer_details.question: Hi, I bought a dining chair 3 weeks ago and changed my mind, can I bring it back?
answer_details.sources:
[S1] (Returns policy) Most items can be returned within 60 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Sofas, sectionals, upholstered furniture and mattresses have a 30-day return window and a $149 return pickup fee.
[S2] (Delivery policy) Standard parcel delivery arrives in 3 to 7 business days and is free on orders over $99. White glove delivery for furniture is scheduled within 2 to 4 weeks, and our delivery partner calls 48 hours ahead to confirm a 4-hour window.
[S3] (Delivery policy) White glove includes in-room placement, assembly and packaging removal for a flat $199. You can reschedule or change a white glove delivery date at no charge up to 72 hours before the appointment, from the Orders page or by contacting Client Care.
answer_details.answer: Yes, you should be able to return it. Most items can be returned within 60 days of delivery for a full refund to your original payment method [S1]. Upholstered furniture has a shorter 30-day window and a $149 return pickup fee [S1]. At about 3 weeks, you're inside both windows. If your chair is upholstered, the $149 pickup fee would apply [S1]. The sources don't say whether dining chairs count as upholstered, so please check yours.

[S1] (Furniture warranty) All Halden furniture carries a 5-year limited warranty against frame and structural defects, including a cracked leg, broken joints and frame failure on tables, chairs and sofas. Fabric wear, fading, pet damage and normal wear and tear are not covered.
[S2] (Damaged or defective items) If an item arrives damaged, broken or defective, report it within 7 days of delivery with photos of the item and the packaging. We send a free replacement or issue a full refund, and you do not need to return broken decor items such as vases or lamps under $150.
[S3] (Damaged or defective items) For damaged furniture we schedule a technician repair or a replacement at no cost.
answer_details.answer: Yes, this should be covered. Your side table's broken leg falls under our 5-year limited warranty against frame and structural defects, which includes a cracked leg on tables [S1]. At one year of normal use, you're well within that period. For furniture, we schedule a technician repair or a replacement at no cost [S3]. Please contact Client Care with photos so we can confirm the best fix.
answer_details.unsupported: The instruction to contact Client Care with photos to confirm the fix is not in the sources. The photo requirement for warranty claims is not among these sources, and the technician repair or replacement in [S3] is stated for damaged furniture, not for warranty claims.
